findings.detail: C01 denominator is counting unfunded debt commitment rows whose source Interest Rate column is explicitly blank/dash; the residual fair value ties to Total Unfunded Debt Investments of (536).

rationale: The raw source schedule has funded debt rows with populated Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate columns, while unfunded debt rows such as PetVet Care Centers, LLC - Undrawn show dashes in those rate columns. The C01 residual_fv is -536000, matching the source Total Unfunded Debt Investments fair value of (536) in thousands. The low rate coverage is therefore caused by including source-unrated unfunded commitments in the denominator, not by a missing extraction from funded debt rows.
